note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole verse, verses joined, or the shortest span carrying the quoted clause (pieces joined with … where Murray drops words). `self_rendered` rows are quotations Murray recasts to fit his sentence (re-personed or blended: Exod 23:22 as a command, John 17:17 'sanctify me', 'as I hear, so I speak' from John 5:30/8:26, Col 3:10 'renewed day by day'), and allusions or paraphrases in his own voice, left as the translator's prose.
